scope: Public, previously exposed development workbook. Local original-to-Docling-layout cell comparison; not independent evaluation or production upload acceptance.
method: Loaded the original workbook read-only with openpyxl data_only=true. For each of five sheets, compared every original cell at its one-based row and column coordinate with the corresponding extracted table header/row value. Exact comparison used Python string values; content comparison collapsed whitespace. Also checked workbook formula, chart and image counts and ZIP visual parts.
